# Collaboration Request

Please send me the following information:

1. The live app link.
2. The GitHub repository link.
3. The exact prompt or command I should paste into my terminal.

Please include the terminal prompt or command every time you send me a message about a new update. This will help me apply, commit, or push the latest changes from my computer.

If the command changes depending on the update, please provide the complete updated command and briefly explain what it will do.
